## permissionedBackedTokens variable

The registry of all known permissioned wrapped Backed tokens. All permissioned Backed tokens are considered ERC20Wrapper and automatically added to the erc20WrapperTokens registry.

**Signature:**

```typescript
permissionedBackedTokens: Record<number, Set<`0x${string}`>>
```
